# tenzir_organization_member (Resource)

Makes an existing user a member of an organization, without an invitation, and keeps the member's roles to exactly `role_ids`. It is for the account that manages an organization a platform administrator set up with `plan = "provisioned"`, which starts without members: make that account, from `tenzir_current_user`, its owner. It is not for the people who use the organization, who join by invitation or, for the demo organization, by signing up.

Needs `Organization.addMember`, which only platform administrators hold, `Organization.listMembers`, `OrganizationRole.assignToMember` and `OrganizationRole.revokeFromMember` on the roles, and `OrganizationMember.remove`.

The platform refuses a change to an organization's roles or members that leaves nobody able to restore access to it, so the other resources of the organization should `depends_on` this one. For the same reason, the platform keeps the last member who can; destroying this resource then only warns, and the membership goes with the organization. The platform refuses to add a user who already is a member; import such a member instead. Do not also manage the member's roles with `tenzir_role_assignment`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The account that Terraform runs as manages the organization, so it becomes
# the owner of the organization it set up.
resource "tenzir_organization" "demo" {
  slug = "demo"
  plan = "provisioned"
}

data "tenzir_current_user" "terraform" {}

resource "tenzir_organization_member" "terraform" {
  organization_id = tenzir_organization.demo.id
  user_id         = data.tenzir_current_user.terraform.id
  role_ids        = ["org.owner"]
}

# The platform refuses a change to the organization's roles while nobody can
# restore access to it, so roles wait for the owner.
resource "tenzir_role" "visitor" {
  organization_id = tenzir_organization.demo.id
  label           = "Visitor"
  color           = "neutral"
  policy = jsonencode([
    [{ target = { _tag = "Organization", orgId = tenzir_organization.demo.id }, relationships = [] }, ["Organization.read"]],
  ])

  depends_on = [tenzir_organization_member.terraform]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) The ID or slug of the organization.
- `user_id` (String) The ID of the user.

### Optional

- `role_ids` (Set of String) Built-in role IDs such as `org.member`, or custom roles' IDs. Defaults to none.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The member ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <organization>/<user ID>, with the organization by ID or slug.
terraform import tenzir_organization_member.terraform demo/01a1a205-9e50-7d13-bac1-3f47f9cc4297
```
